rewrites.//: SPA fallback. This is what makes /connect/callback resolve — without it Vercel 404s on a path with no file, and the OAuth redirect dies before the app ever loads. /api/* is excluded so serverless functions still route.

headers.//: The page must not be framable: an attacker framing the connect screen could trick someone into authorising a provider (clickjacking).
frame-src is the one permissive directive, and only for the two sanctioned embed origins — Tier 2 is exactly this and nothing else.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://open.spotify.com https://www.youtube.com https://s.ytimg.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https:; media-src 'none'; connect-src 'self' https://api.spotify.com https://www.googleapis.com https://oauth2.googleapis.com https://*.workers.dev; frame-src https://open.spotify.com https://www.youtube.com https://www.youtube-nocookie.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
